We use cookies to improve your experience. Privacy policy

Widget Summit 2026 is in Lisbon this autumn, and registration is open to every Widget user.

Getting started

The Widget CLI is distributed as a single binary for Linux, macOS and Windows. Download the archive for your platform, unpack it, and put the binary on your PATH.

Run widget init inside an empty folder to create a project skeleton. The command writes a widget.toml configuration file and a src directory with an example pipeline.

Use widget run to execute the pipeline locally. Logs are written to the .widget/logs folder and the exit code is non-zero when any stage fails.

Configuration reference

Configuration lives in widget.toml at the project root. Values can be overridden per environment with WIDGET_ prefixed environment variables.

The workers key sets the number of parallel stages. The default is the number of CPU cores, and values above 64 are clamped.

Widget Summit 2026 is in Lisbon this autumn, and registration is open to every Widget user.

Troubleshooting

If widget run exits with code 3, a stage timed out. Increase timeout_s in widget.toml or split the stage into smaller steps.

Permission errors on macOS usually mean the binary is quarantined. Remove the quarantine attribute or install through your package manager instead.
